title: Recover P via the revised GT STNFS core with refiltered LA (R6): 121.700920167243655

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm in proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied uniform nonidentity Q and uniform z (P = infinity exactly for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound 0.391949 - 2^-48), conditional on H1-H5 of source-core.md. It computes g=e(P0,Q), exactly uniform on GT minus {1} and independent of z, maps g and z into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of proof.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core (REVISION.md R1-R6: 99.9% ECM on theta=207/500, chunk scatter, 10.01 route, 13/entry LA with 23x4 blocks, exact prices, 0.05% reserve, refiltered N/U 0.0662 with 100.7/entry) and returns P=[a]P0 after checking e(P,Q)=z. The core's upper-rounded complete ledger is below 2^121.700199 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, both pairings, verification and output, is at most (2001/2000) x 2^121.700199 + 2^80/20000 < 2^121.700920167243655 units. Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes every quantity changed by REVISION.md from the shipped code and data: region, count products, yield and margin, work SE and allowance, ECM schedules, the R3 route count (measurements12.txt R3 lines, STORAGE.md listing), the R4 finishing budget, linear algebra and generator, the descent recurrence, counter and repeat terms, success and the full ledger; then the recover-P total and success. Does not rerun unchanged inherited certificates.

Optional full recomputation of all inherited certificates (resultant, tower, rho, pool regeneration, filtering, retention, ECM toys, fields, alpha, audit) together with the revised model and declared bounds.
